title: Resource
description: A directory entry naming a resource type a project can draw on (a role, a unit, an external party, a system, a facility, or something else), declared once and picked by a project's own People and resources section rather than typed afresh each time. Free-text stays allowed when no catalogue entry fits (Project.spec.resources[].title).
